mapper.sql: p.id, p.employee_id, e.emp_no, e.name AS employee_name, e.department, p.period, p.score, p.self_desc, p.status, r.name AS reviewer_name, p.review_comment, p.submitted_at, p.reviewed_at
mapper.select: SELECT id, employee_id, period, score, self_desc, status, reviewer_id, review_comment, submitted_at, reviewed_at FROM performance_record WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, employee_id, period, score, self_desc, status, reviewer_id, review_comment, submitted_at, reviewed_at FROM performance_record WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND period = #{period}
SELECT FROM performance_record p JOIN employee e ON e.id = p.employee_id LEFT JOIN employee r ON r.id = p.reviewer_id WHERE p.employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY p.period DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM performance_record WHERE status = 'PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO performance_record (employee_id, period, score, self_desc, status, submitted_at) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{period}, #{score}, #{selfDesc}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE performance_record SET score = #{score}, self_desc = #{selfDesc}, submitted_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND employee_id = #{employeeId} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE performance_record SET score = #{score}, self_desc = #{selfDesc}, status = 'PENDING', reviewer_id = NULL, review_comment = NULL, submitted_at = NOW(), reviewed_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND employee_id = #{employeeId} AND status = 'REJECTED'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM performance_record WHERE id = #{id} AND employee_id = #{employeeId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.update: UPDATE performance_record SET status = #{status}, review_comment = #{comment}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, reviewed_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT p.employee_id, p.period, p.score, p.status FROM performance_record p WHERE p.status = 'APPROVED' AND p.period >= #{fromMonth} AND p.employee_id IN #{id} ORDER BY p.period
